targetText: In present-day bourgeois society woman holds the second place. Man leads; she follows.
summary: Exploring human physiology and psychology, Bebel refutes reactionary claims that women are naturally inferior in intellect, arguing that centuries of social subordination and denial of education account for artificial disparities, and condemning the suppression of healthy human sexuality under bourgeois hypocrisy.
